fixes_applied.summary: Fixed invalid approval fallback, required-fields CSV normalization, resolved dry-run launch flags, and strengthened self-tests for #266.

findings.issue: Invalid approval values warned but did not force PROFILE_APPROVAL back to prompt, so a prior approval=auto line in the same profile could survive an invalid value.
result_required_fields CSV parsing trimmed spaces but kept empty entries from whitespace-only or trailing-comma values, causing empty field names to be treated as required fields.
dry-run invocation.launch_flags showed the preset value instead of the resolved LAUNCH_FLAGS value, so env overrides were not reflected in the preview.

notes: Ran scripts/ci-shellcheck, skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux codex self-test, and skills/tmux-agent-tools/scripts/agent-tmux claude self-test after commit; all returned 0. No push performed.
